cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the system checks fingerprints, face or iris to stop one person enrolling twice; 1:N matching is described for proving identity in the Mon e-ID app.
cells.note: Stage 3: the electronic national ID card (CNIE) is in service, with 32 million issued by February 2025. iDAKTO's account of 1:N matching to prove identity in the Mon e-ID app, like biometric verification at renewal, does not show enrolments checked for duplicates, so stage 4 is not met.
